name: housely
description: Organize a shared flat: a fair weekly chore rotation, completion tracking and a Tricount link, as an installable offline PWA.
author: Glinbor10

scripts.dev: npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --ui --project demo-housely "vite --mode emulators"
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-housely "vitest run --config firebase/firestore/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.dev:seed: npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --ui --project demo-housely "node scripts/seed.mjs && vite --mode emulators"
scripts.screenshots: npx vite build --mode emulators && npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-housely "node scripts/seed.mjs && node scripts/screenshots.mjs"
scripts.screenshots:guide: npx vite build --mode emulators && npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-housely "node scripts/seed.mjs && node scripts/guide-screenshots.mjs"
scripts.e2e:emulator: npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-housely "playwright test -c e2e/emulator.config.ts"
